title: When Bibliographies Learn from Themselves: Measuring and Controlling Scope Drift in AI-Assisted Scholarly Curation
unit_of_scope: user-controlled canonical bibliography plus boundary text
core_evaluation_principle: Primary success is positive-holdout admissible-group recovery under groups frozen before the holdout is examined. Exact-paper rank is secondary; papers absent from a bibliography are unlabeled rather than negatives.

kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.purpose: visual analytics, guidance, knowledge lens, and sensemaking needed to interpret source figures and tables
kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.query: knowledge guided visual analytics domain knowledge provenance traceable insight

kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.purpose: provenance, traceability, and evidence mechanisms needed to make an insight auditable
kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.query: visual analytics insight provenance sensemaking synthesis multiple insights

kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.purpose: rainfall or precipitation evidence that operationalizes the lens through diurnal pattern, amount, frequency, intensity, peak timing, spatial pattern, or uncertainty
kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.query: diurnal rainfall amount frequency intensity peak hour spatial visualization

kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.purpose: work that connects a knowledge/visual-analytic method to empirical rainfall evidence or a traceable claim
kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.query: narrative visualization evidence provenance data storytelling traceability

candidate_admission.rule: A candidate is eligible only when its title and abstract provide explicit evidence that it fills at least one frozen evidence-group purpose and a missing role in that group.
candidate_admission.not_a_rule: Topical similarity or recency alone is insufficient.
candidate_admission.redundancy_interpretation: Similarity is expected for retrieval. Difference matters only after group fit: the candidate must add a distinct citable role, mechanism, evidence type, setting, or limitation.

parameters.recursion_stop_rule: Stop early when every frozen group is at capacity or no candidate passes admission with a missing role under the active threshold version.
parameters.twenty_percent_bag_role: optional severe-incompleteness stress test only; not a primary confidence condition

marginal_coverage_definition.target: the evidence groups and anchor families frozen from the user-declared scope before holdout inspection
marginal_coverage_definition.state: for each frozen group, the greatest anchored cosine similarity supplied by the active bibliography
marginal_coverage_definition.candidate_gain: the mean positive improvement a candidate makes over that current group-wise evidence frontier
marginal_coverage_definition.recursive_update: accepted candidates update the frontier before the next round
marginal_coverage_definition.convergence: no eligible candidate exceeds the frozen marginal-gain threshold
marginal_coverage_definition.boundary: this measures missing concept coverage; a newer replacement for an already-covered concept can correctly receive zero gain

confirmatory_corpus_rule: Treat each student project and artifact boundary as an independent corpus. Do not pool a lab-wide bibliography or mix proposal and paper workstreams. Register and freeze the canonical BibTeX snapshot, scope text, evidence groups, and temporal cutoffs before any candidate retrieval.

retrospective_validation.positive_label: a dated paper that the researcher added to the same bibliography after the cutoff
retrospective_validation.holdout_access_rule: held-out later papers cannot be retrieval seeds, scoring anchors, or post-hoc group definitions
retrospective_validation.primary_success_definition: a held-out later inclusion belongs to an admissible evidence group represented by eligible output; exact paper rank is secondary
retrospective_validation.group_definition_rule: freeze claim/evidence roles, boundary facets, or independent communities from pre-cutoff inputs; each group has a capacity budget
retrospective_validation.openalex_metrics_role: secondary outcome-validity descriptors only; they are not inclusion ground truth and current graph metadata may leak future availability

confirmatory_requirement: Add independently authored, multi-domain corpora with recorded scope statements before making general claims.

late_pruning_validation.primary_result: group recall improved over fixed Top-10 on both held-out cutoffs
late_pruning_validation.secondary_result: exact recovery passed in 2023 and failed strict non-inferiority by 2 bag-positive hits in 2024
late_pruning_validation.supported_role: experimental coverage layer beside fixed Core ranking
late_pruning_validation.forbidden_action: do not retune v2 on 2023 or 2024

execution_policy.gpu_rule: Use GPU only when a CUDA-enabled PyTorch environment detects a usable device; CPU multicore execution remains the reproducible baseline.
execution_policy.openalex_parallelism_rule: Parallelize local bagging/scoring only. Keep network retrieval bounded and cache-first; never increase API concurrency merely because more CPU cores are available.

human_review_workbook_pipeline.gate: The declared workbook pipeline must pass input-hash, schema, row-count, title, abstract, and deterministic-output checks before adjudication files are distributed or included in the reproducibility package.
